server.name: io.github.baianomarceloeduardo-jpg/automaton-token-safety-mcp
server.description: Base L2 token safety for AI agents: honeypot scans, swap simulation, approval and liquidity risk.
server.title: Automaton Token Safety

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Automaton Token Safety API the tools call.
environmentVariables.name: VALUE_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Origin URL for routes the edge defers with a use_origin answer (for example the free conformance checker). Optional; without it such a tool reports which variable to set.
environmentVariables.name: AUTOMATON_ORIGIN_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Private key of the wallet that pays for calls. The server only SIGNS an EIP-3009 authorisation; it never sends a transaction. Also required: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND=1, and this key is not loaded into the process without it. Never set this to the payee/treasury wallet: that is rejected.
environmentVariables.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_PAYER_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to permit this server to sign paid calls. Any other value (including absent) leaves every paid tool answering with the price only.
environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_OUTBOUND_SPEND

environmentVariables.description: Per-call ceiling in USDC base units (6 decimals, so 10000 = 0.01 USDC). A requirement above it is refused before signing.
environmentVariables.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS

environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for the whole process lifetime, in USDC base units. Stops a runaway loop, not just a single expensive call.
environmentVariables.name: AUTOMATON_MCP_TOTAL_CAP_UNITS

environmentVariables.description: When set, serve Streamable HTTP on this port instead of stdio. Binds to 127.0.0.1 by default.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
